_meta.description: Compose batch of one reference slot (control treatment arm) plus one target slot (variant treatment arm) grouped by region decorated with an OVERLAY_Z_VS_REF series-shape compose overlay that runs a per-group two-sample z-test against the matching reference group. Cell aggregator is AGG_WELFORD which emits the streaming Welford-Pebay triple {Mean, Variance, N} as the per-group payload via the RichAggregator interface — the OVERLAY_Z_VS_REF handler is triple-aware (mirrors OVERLAY_Z_CELL) so variance and n are read from the streaming sample state instead of the Params defaults. v0.20.0 parity overlay (E1 family) — series-shape sibling of OVERLAY_Z_CELL with byte-equal parity against the standalone TEST_Z_TWO_SAMPLE row test for the same (mean, variance, n) triple. Each entry's Statistic becomes the two-sided z p-value. Reuses the standardNormalCDF helper backing TEST_Z_TWO_SAMPLE / OVERLAY_Z_CELL. Twin to OVERLAY_T_VS_REF (32_compose_t_vs_ref.json) — same fold-and-finalise shape, different finalising distribution (standard normal vs Student's t). Missing reference groups emit PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO with ref_missing=true Detail. Inherently buffered — inferential overlays as a family stay buffered until a streamable-test path is plumbed (PRD Non-Goals).
_meta.name: compose-z-vs-ref
